assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: original editorial website article cover, landscape 3:2. A realistic small American apartment entryway with warm white walls, pale oak plank floor, a muted rust and cream flatwoven rectangular runner lying completely flat with no fringe, positioned beyond the swing of a white entry door open inward at 80 degrees. Slim oak bench against the side wall with one canvas bag, simple ceramic key bowl on a narrow wall shelf. The floor around the door is clear; door stops before rug edge. Eye-level oblique wide view, soft autumn daylight, restrained warm earthy color palette, authentic woven texture, attractive lived-in home magazine photography. Physically coherent single door and frame. No people, no text, no branding, no watermark, no diagram. Not a luxury mansion. Show full rug outline and open door within frame.
